title: AI just changed team size forever.
description:
Geoff Charles, CPO at Ramp, explains how AI is changing product velocity—and why a highly enabled individual can potentially accomplish what previously required a 10–15 person team.

The future of work may not simply mean more AI replacing people.It may mean smaller teams with dramatically more leverage.

#AI #FutureOfWork #Startups #Tech #Shorts
